tests.title: Token store keeps no plain-text token

steps.action: Search the store for the token value

tests.expected_result: The stored record holds a hash; searching the store for the token value finds nothing

tests.title: Reset request sends one email and does not reveal accounts
tests.expected_result: One email for the known address; identical responses for known and unknown addresses

tests.title: Only a fresh, unused token sets a new password
tests.preconditions: Tokens issued 29 and 31 minutes ago; one already used
tests.expected_result: Only the 29-minute unused token succeeds; the others are rejected and the password is unchanged

tests.title: Account locks at the confirmed threshold
tests.expected_result: The account locks at the threshold confirmed by Q-002
